subject: NimbleHealth video testimonial — filming plan, script & release
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Diane Park <diane.park@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Video testimonial invite + quick plan (Redwood x NimbleHealth)

Hi Diane —

Thanks again for agreeing to do a short customer video with us. Really excited to share NimbleHealth’s story about latency-sensitive inference in production — I think it will resonate with our developer audience.

High level ask: a 3–4 minute on-camera piece (single speaker from Nimble) covering the problem you had, how you used Redwood Inference, and one measurable outcome. We’ll handle filming, editing, and a short release for sign-off.

Proposed next steps:
- I’ll send a draft script and talking points for review (attached).
- Schedule a 90‑minute on-site shoot (or remote video option) — what’s easiest for you?
- We’ll route a release to your legal team for signature.

Are you available for shoot windows the week of Oct 18 or Oct 25? If you prefer remote, we can do a high-quality Zoom capture with our director and send a pre-call checklist.

Attachment: script_v1.docx (draft talking points)

If that all sounds good I’ll loop in Rishi (production/tech) and Marissa (CS) to coordinate logistics.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

From: Diane Park <diane.park@nimblehealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Video Ops <video_ops@nimblehealth.com>, Samir Shah <samir.shah@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Video testimonial invite + quick plan (Redwood x NimbleHealth)

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the note and the draft — we reviewed it internally and like the direction. We can do an on-site shoot on Oct 21 between 9am–12pm PT; that works best for our product lead who will be speaking.

A couple of quick questions from Legal: they want to see the release language before we confirm. Also, can you share a shot list so our facilities team knows space/tech needs?

I’ve cc’d our video ops and Samir from Legal — Samir, would you be able to glance at the release and flag anything?

Cheers,
Diane Park
Head of Product | NimbleHealth
diane.park@nimblehealth.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Diane Park <diane.park@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Video testimonial invite + quick plan (Redwood x NimbleHealth)

Perfect — Oct 21 9am–12pm is penciled in on our side.

Attached: release_form_v2.pdf (standard Redwood release) and shot_list.xlsx (preliminary). Rishi will follow up with the technical checklist and AV requirements; Marissa will be the day-of CS contact.

Key things in the release: limited rights for marketing use across web/social, thirty‑day approval window for the final cut, and standard indemnity language. If Legal needs edits we can accept redlines and route back via DocuSign.

Attachment: release_form_v2.pdf, shot_list.xlsx, script_v1.docx

Rishi — can you add any equipment constraints or sample shot list details for Diane’s facilities team?

Thanks —
Jasmine

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Diane Park <diane.park@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Video testimonial invite + quick plan (Redwood x NimbleHealth)

Thanks — quick production notes from our side:

- Crew: 2-person crew (director + camera/op). They travel light; we typically need a 12x12ft clear space, power access, and a quiet background.
- A/V: We’ll bring a 1/4" lavalier mic kit and a compact LED key + fill. If you have a house AV person they can provide a monitor for playback.
- Remote option: if you opt for remote, we’ll run a tech check 48h prior and provide a Zoom upload link for full-res files.
- Shot ideas: single speaker medium-close, B-roll of engineers at a whiteboard, screen capture of the dashboard (we’ll coordinate data masking with Samir if needed).

Attached: shot_list.xlsx (detailed)

Diane — any building access notes or parking instructions we should know?

—Rishi
Lead Video Producer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@nimblehealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Diane Park <diane.park@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Video testimonial invite + quick plan (Redwood x NimbleHealth)

Jasmine —

Quick legal redline attached. Small ask: please change clause 4 to specify that any dashboard screenshots used in the video must have customer PII removed and that NimbleHealth reserves a right to request edits within 30 calendar days after delivery. The current draft is close but we prefer explicit language on screenshots and the timeline spelled out.

I’ve attached release_redline.pdf with annotations. If you can accept these edits, please send back a DocuSign envelope for signature — we’ll return it quickly.

Attachment: release_redline.pdf

Thanks,
Samir (Legal)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Diane Park <diane.park@nimblehealth.com>, Samir Shah <samir.shah@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2026 15:44:00 -0700
Subject: Finalized release + DocuSign link + day-of plan (Oct 21)

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Samir. We reviewed the redlines and accepted the clause changes you requested: we updated clause 4 to explicitly require masking/removal of PII in any screenshots and preserved a 30‑day edit window.

DocuSign link for the finalized release: https://www.docusign.net/Signing/StartEnvelope.aspx?envelopeId=12345-TEST

Day-of plan (Oct 21):
- 08:45 — crew arrives and sets up in Conference B (12x14).
- 09:00 — tech check with Nimble product lead (15 min).
- 09:20 — hair/mic and quick script run-through.
- 09:40–10:10 — on-camera interview (single take + backup).
- 10:10–11:00 — B-roll: workspace, engineer shots, demo capture.

Attachments uploaded to shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Nimble-Redwood-Testimonial (script_v1.docx, shot_list.xlsx, release_form_final.pdf)

Marissa Cole
Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0188

P.S. Diane — if you want a remote option as a fallback, we can schedule a pre-call and send a tech checklist the day before.
